project.name: Shinobi V3
project.description: Shinobi V3 is a deterministic in-memory object graph kernel for infrastructure-as-code that compiles manifest-defined relationships into backend-neutral intents, evaluates compliance policy, and lowers the result to deployable AWS resources through Pulumi. It is a backend-neutral, policy-driven pnpm + Nx TypeScript monorepo with auditable, structured outputs suitable for CI automation. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

layers.name: Contracts & IR Foundation
layers.description: Backend-neutral base types, interfaces, and the Node/Edge/DerivedArtifact graph model with canonical ordering and semantic hashing that all other packages build on.

layers.name: Validation
layers.description: Deterministic schema, semantic, and determinism validators that enforce structured, stable-path errors over graph snapshots.

layers.name: Kernel
layers.description: In-memory graph engine providing the mutation API, deterministic compilation pipeline, canonical serialization, and the facade that composes binders and policy evaluators.

layers.name: Binder
layers.description: Edge compiler that maps binding directives and edge context into backend-neutral intents (IAM, network, config, telemetry) without branching on policy packs.

layers.name: Policy
layers.description: Config-driven compliance engine: rule catalog, severity map, and evaluators that inspect intents and nodes across the Baseline, FedRAMP-Moderate, and FedRAMP-High packs.

layers.name: AWS Adapter
layers.description: Provider-bound layer that lowers backend-neutral intents and nodes into Pulumi AWS resources and drives deploy/preview via the Pulumi Automation API (the only place provider SDKs appear).

layers.name: CLI
layers.description: User-facing validate/plan/up commands, the YAML manifest parser, and graph-builder that turn service manifests into kernel mutations and Pulumi deployments.

layers.name: Conformance & Dev Tooling
layers.description: Golden-case and triad-matrix conformance framework plus audit and code-generation scripts (lowerer/policy/golden generators, gate-coverage and FedRAMP audits).

layers.name: Blueprints & Manifests
layers.description: Declarative infrastructure-as-data YAML blueprints across ai, compute, and infra domains that exercise the kernel-to-adapter pipeline.

layers.name: Build, Config & Documentation
layers.description: Monorepo build and tooling configuration (Nx, pnpm, TypeScript, Jest, Prettier), GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, the mcporter config, and top-level project documentation.
